CHAPTER.VERS: He said and to the disciples: Impossible it is of the not to come the snares; woe but, through whom they come.
It is possible for him if a millstone upper was hung about the neck of him and have been thrown into the sea, than he should ensnare one of the little ones these.
Take heed to yourselves. If and should sin against thee the brother of thee, rebuke him; and if he should reform, forgive him.
And if seven times of the day he should sin against thee, and seven times of the day he should turn, saying: I reform; thou shalt forgive him.
And said the apostles to the Lord: Do thou add to us faith.
Said and the Lord: If you had faith as a grain of mustard, you might say to the sycaminetree this: Be thou uprooted, and be thou planted in the sea; and it would obey you.
Which but of you a slave having ploughing or feeding cattle, who having come out of the field will say: Immediately going do thou recline?
But not will say to him: Make ready what I may sup, and having girded do thou serve me, till I may eat and drink; and after these shalt eat and drink thou?
Not favor has the slave that, because he did the things having been commanded? No I think.
So also you, when you shall have done all the things having been commanded you, say you: That slaves unprofitable we are; because what we were bound to do, we have done.
And it happened in the to go him to Jerusalem, and he passed through midst of Samaria and Galilee.
And entering of him into a certain village, met him ten leprous men, who stood far off.
And they lifted up a voice, saying: Jesus master pity us.
And seeing he said to them: Going show you yourselves to the priests. And it happened in the to go them, they were cleansed.
One and of them, saying that he was cured turned back, with a voice loud glorifying the God;
and fell on face at the feet of him, giving thanks to him; and he was a Samaritan.
Answering and the Jesus said: Not the ten were cleansed? the but nine where?
Not they found having returned to give glory to the God, except the foreigner this?
And he said to him: Arising go thou; the faith of thee has saved thee.
Having been asked and by the Pharisees, when comes the kingdom of the God, he answered them, and said: Not comes the kingdom of the God with careful watching;
nor will they say: Lo here, or, or there; lo for, the majesty of the God in the midst of you is.
He said and to the disciples: Will come days, when you will desire one of the days of the son of the man to see; and not you will see.
And they will say to you: Lo here, or, lo there; not you may go away, nor may you follow.
Even as for the lightening, that flashing out of the under heaven, to the under heaven shines; so will be the son of the man in the day of him.
First but it behooves him many things to suffer, and to rejected from the generation this.
And as it happened in the days of Noah, so it will be also in the days of the son of the man.
They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, till of which day entered Noah into the ark; and came the flood, and destroyed all.
In like manner also as it happened in the days of Lot; they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;
in the but day went out Lot from Sodom, it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed all;
according to these it will be in the day the son of the man is revealed.
In that the day, who will be on the roof, and the goods of him in the house, not let him descend to take them; and he in the field, in like manner not let him turn for the things behind.
Remember you of the wife of Lot.
Whoever may seek the life of himself to save will lose her; and whoever may lose her, will preserve her.
I say to you: In this the night will be two on bed one; one will be taken, and the other will be left.
Two will be grinding on the same; the one will be taken, and the other will be left.
And answering they said to him: Where, O Lord? He and said to them: Where the body, there will be gathered the eagles.
